school.name: Bronx Studio School for Writers and Artists
school.overview: Our mission is to educate, empower and embolden our students, school and community.  Our faculty and partners work tirelessly to ensure that our school is a learning environment open to all students, regardless of academic ability, and that every student is prepared for college and the world beyond. We value academic challenge, social justice, individualization, and high-quality teaching.
